# Liberal Democrats Manifesto 2024 Summary

## Overview
The Liberal Democrats' 2024 manifesto, titled "For a Fair Deal," presents a comprehensive vision for transforming British politics and addressing what they describe as years of Conservative neglect across healthcare, the economy, environment, and public services.

## Key Themes

### Economy
The party pledges responsible fiscal management while investing in green infrastructure and renewable energy. Key proposals include replacing business rates with a Commercial Landowner Levy, creating Lifelong Skills Grants of £5,000 for adult education, and fixing the UK's relationship with Europe to remove trade barriers. They commit to fair taxation, including reversing bank tax cuts and increasing the Digital Services Tax on tech giants.

### Healthcare
The NHS receives significant focus, with promises to guarantee GP appointments within seven days (24 hours for urgent cases) by recruiting 8,000 additional GPs. They pledge to guarantee NHS dental access for emergency care, boost cancer survival rates with a 62-day treatment guarantee, and place mental health professionals in every school. Social care reform includes introducing free personal care and creating a Royal College of Care Workers.

### Environment
Environmental commitments include achieving net zero by 2045, generating 90% of electricity from renewables by 2030, and launching an emergency home insulation programme. The party promises to tackle the sewage scandal by transforming water companies into public benefit companies, banning executive bonuses until pollution ends, and replacing Ofwat with a stronger regulator.

### Housing
Housing proposals include building 380,000 homes annually (150,000 social homes), creating ten new garden cities, abolishing residential leaseholds, and banning no-fault evictions. They would give councils powers to end Right to Buy locally.

### Education
Education pledges include placing mental health professionals in every school, increasing per-pupil funding above inflation, reinstating maintenance grants for disadvantaged students, and providing free school meals for all children in poverty.

### Political Reform
The manifesto proposes significant constitutional changes: introducing proportional representation for MPs and English councillors, giving 16-17 year-olds voting rights, capping political donations, reforming the House of Lords, and creating a federal UK structure.

### International Affairs
Internationally, the party commits to fixing EU relations through a four-stage roadmap ultimately aiming for Single Market membership, supporting Ukraine, returning international development spending to 0.7% of national income, and advocating for a ceasefire in Gaza with recognition of Palestinian statehood.
